segments.name: Network Infrastructure
segments.description: Provides optical, IP and fixed network infrastructure equipment and solutions to telecom providers and enterprise customers.
segments.evidence: Network Infrastructure net sales in 2025 were EUR 7 986 million, an increase of EUR 1 468 million, or 23 %, compared to EUR 6 518 million in 2024 . T he acquisition of Infinera at the end of February contributed EUR 1 273 million in net sales growth.

segments.name: Cloud and Network Services
segments.description: Delivers cloud and network services solutions including enterprise campus edge and managed services to customers.
segments.evidence: Cloud and Network Services net sales in 2025 were EUR 2 606 million, an increase of EUR 17 million, or 1 %, compared to EUR 2 589 million in 2024 .

segments.name: Mobile Networks
segments.description: Provides mobile network infrastructure, software and services to mobile network operators.
segments.evidence: During 2025 , Nokia had four operating and reportable segments for financial reporting purposes: (1) Network Infrastructure, (2) Cloud and Network Services, (3) Mobile Networks and (4) Nokia Technologies.

segments.name: Nokia Technologies
segments.description: Manages technology licensing, patents and intellectual property monetization across Nokia's portfolio.
segments.evidence: During 2025 , Nokia had four operating and reportable segments for financial reporting purposes: (1) Network Infrastructure, (2) Cloud and Network Services, (3) Mobile Networks and (4) Nokia Technologies.

revenueModel.text: Nokia sells infrastructure equipment, software and services to telecommunications providers, enterprises and cloud providers, generating revenue from product sales and service contracts.
revenueModel.evidence: Demand increased from AI & Cloud and Mission Critical Enterprise & Defense customers while demand from telecom providers remained largely stable.

changes.text: In 2025, Nokia moved Managed Services business from Cloud and Network Services to Mobile Networks.
changes.evidence: In 2025, Nokia moved Managed Services business from Cloud and Network Services to Mobile Networks.

changes.text: Nokia acquired Infinera in late February 2025, adding optical networking capabilities to Network Infrastructure segment.
